app.unreachable: The ZimaMC app isn't responding. Check that it is running in ZimaOS, then try again.

setup.intro: Run your own Minecraft server in a few clicks. First, choose a password that protects this page.
setup.passwordHint: At least 6 characters. You'll need it to open ZimaMC.
setup.limitsText: Minecraft servers can use a lot of memory and CPU. Set how much of this machine they may use together, so ZimaOS and your other apps keep running smoothly.

login.title: Log in
login.forgot: Forgot the password? In ZimaOS, open this app's settings, add the variable RESET_PASSWORD=true and restart the app. On Windows, start ZimaMC.exe from a terminal with --reset-password. You can then choose a new password (start normally afterwards).

limits.explain: Every server gets its own memory and CPU limit, and none can be bigger than this. Together they may add up to more: servers rarely all use everything at the same time.

server.crashed: The server stopped unexpectedly. The console usually shows why.

PAPER.name: Paper
PAPER.text: Fast and works with most plugins.

FOLIA.name: Folia
FOLIA.text: Paper for big servers: uses all CPU cores. Only some plugins support it.

FABRIC.name: Fabric
FABRIC.text: Lightweight, great for performance and newer mods.

FORGE.name: Forge
FORGE.text: The classic loader for big modpacks.

dashboard.title: My servers
dashboard.reserved: {{mem}} allowed for running servers (may add up to more than the limit)
dashboard.emptyText: Create your first Minecraft server. It takes about a minute.

newServer.title: Create a server
newServer.gameTitle: What do you want to play?

plugins.name: Plugins
plugins.text: Paper or Folia: add plugins with one click. Paper is best for most people.

vanilla.name: Vanilla
vanilla.text: The official Mojang server, exactly like single player.

mods.name: Mods
mods.text: Fabric or Forge. Every player needs the same mods installed.

newServer.versionHint: Players need the same version in their launcher.
newServer.modsMemoryHint: Modpacks often need more memory: pick at least the middle size.
newServer.eulaPrefix: By creating a server you agree to the
newServer.foliaHint: Folia shines with many players and CPU cores. Give it at least 2 cores. Only plugins marked for Folia are offered.
newServer.playersHint: How many people may be online at once. You decide; you can change it later in the server's settings.
newServer.overBudget: Together with your other running servers this is more than your limit of {{limit}}. That works as long as they aren't all busy at once.

overview.friendsHint: Friends outside your home need a bit of setup.

console.offline: The server is offline. Start it to see its output here.
console.placeholder: Type a command, e.g. say Hello
console.needsOnline: Commands work when the server is online
console.hint: No slash needed. Use ↑ and ↓ for earlier commands.
console.insert: Click to put it in the command box
console.cheatHint: Click a command to put it in the command box. <player> and similar parts are for you to fill in.
console.cheatLiveOffline: Start the server to list every command it knows, including those from mods.
console.cheatLiveEmpty: The server did not list any commands.
console.cheatLiveNote: Asked the running server itself. Some mods and plugins add commands that are not listed here; check their page for those.

basic.whitelist: Let someone join (when the whitelist is on)

console.chunkyHint: Set the area first (radius, center, shape), then start.

chunky.trim: Delete chunks outside the area (then confirm)

none.plugins: No plugins yet. Find some below.
none.mods: No mods yet. Find some below.

plugins.source: From Modrinth, showing only what works with Minecraft {{version}}.
plugins.noResults: Nothing found for this Minecraft version.
plugins.restartNeeded: Restart the server to apply the change.
plugins.removeText: Its settings folder stays, so reinstalling it later keeps your configuration.
plugins.settingsHint: “Settings” opens the files of the plugin or mod so you can edit them. They create their settings the first time the server runs. Restart the server after changing them.

players.whitelistToggle: Only allow players on the whitelist
players.whitelistHint: Recommended when your server is reachable from the internet.

ops.title: Operators
ops.text: Players who can use all commands, like /gamemode and /tp.

backups.title: Backups
backups.explain: A backup contains your worlds, plugins and settings. It can be made while people are playing.
backups.restoreText: The world and settings will go back to how they were on {{date}}. Anything newer is lost, so consider backing up first.
backups.restoreStopFirst: Stop the server first, then restore.
backups.restored: Backup restored. Start the server to play.
backups.scheduleHint: Automatic backups only run while the server is running. Manual backups are never deleted automatically.

files.hint: Click a file to edit it. To add a world, upload its folder's files into a new folder and set level-name in server.properties.
files.name: Name
files.restartHint: Most changes apply after a restart.
files.deleteFolderText: The folder and everything in it will be deleted. This can't be undone.

domain.title: Let friends join
domain.intro: Pick the simplest option that works for you. You can change it any time.
domain.cgnat: Your internet provider shares one public address between many customers (CGNAT), so opening a port won't work. Use option 3, the tunnel.

l1.title: Your internet address
l1.noIp: We couldn't find your public address. Check the internet connection.
l1.fail: The server can't be reached from the internet. Try "Open port automatically", or forward TCP port {{port}} to this machine in your router's settings.
l1.unknown: We couldn't run the test right now. Try again in a minute.
l1.manual: Manual router setup: forward TCP port {{port}} to {{ip}}.

l2.title: Your own domain
l2.text: Connect a domain you own on Cloudflare, e.g. mc.yourname.com. We create the records and update them when your address changes.
l2.step0: You need a domain on a free Cloudflare account.
l2.step1: – everything is already filled in. Scroll down and click Continue to summary, then Create Token.
l2.step2: Copy the token and paste it here.
l2.name: Name
l2.what: We'll point this name at your internet address. Port {{port}} is included automatically, so players only type the name.

l3.title: Tunnel (no router needed)
l3.text: For internet providers that block incoming connections. Uses a free address from playit.gg.
l3.explain: playit.gg forwards players to your server, so you don't need to change anything on your router. You'll approve this machine once in a free playit.gg account; ZimaMC does the rest.
l3.openClaim: Open playit.gg and log in or create a free account
l3.approve: Click Accept to add this machine. This page updates by itself.

state.WaitingForUserVisit: Waiting for you to open the link…
state.UserRejected: The request was declined. Start again if that was a mistake.

l3.waiting: Creating the tunnel, this takes up to a minute…

settings.name: Server name
settings.performanceHint: More memory helps with more players and mods.
settings.versionWarn: Back up first. Updating usually works, but going back to an older version can damage the world.
settings.onlineMode: Check player accounts with Mojang (online mode)
settings.offlineWarn: Without the account check, anyone can join with any name, including yours. Only turn this off if you know why.
settings.savedRestart: Saved. Restart the server to apply the changes.
settings.deleteText: The server, its worlds and its backups will be deleted. This can't be undone.
settings.keepFiles: Keep the world and backup files on disk

global.title: Settings
global.limitsText: How much of this machine all Minecraft servers may use together.
global.upnp: Open ports on the router automatically (UPnP)
global.upnpHint: Works with most home routers. Turn off if your network admin doesn't allow it.
global.addLanguage: Missing your language? Add it on GitHub, it's one file.

errors.offline: Can't reach ZimaMC. Check your connection.
errors.password_too_short: The password needs at least 6 characters.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.already_set_up: ZimaMC is already set up. Log in instead.
errors.limit_memory: This server would need {{need}}, which is more than your whole limit ({{free}}). Give it less memory or raise the limit in Settings.
errors.limit_cpu: This server wants more CPU ({{need}} cores) than your limit allows ({{free}}). Lower it in the server's settings or raise the limit.
errors.memory_too_low: A server needs at least 512 MB of memory.
errors.cpu_too_low: A server needs at least a quarter of a CPU core.
errors.is_directory: That's a folder, not a file.
errors.file_too_large: This file is too large to edit here. Download it instead.
errors.binary_file: This file isn't text. Download it instead.
errors.docker_unavailable: ZimaMC can't reach Docker. On Windows, install and start Docker Desktop. On ZimaOS, make sure the app has access to /var/run/docker.sock.
errors.network_error: Couldn't reach {{url}}. Check the internet connection.
errors.download_failed: The download failed. Try again later.
errors.versions_unavailable: Couldn't load the list of Minecraft versions. Check the internet connection.
errors.invalid_version: That isn't a valid Minecraft version.
errors.invalid_port: The port must be a number between 1024 and 65535.
errors.port_in_use: Port {{port}} is already used by another server or app.
errors.no_free_port: No free port found between 25565 and 25664.
errors.server_busy: The server is still starting or stopping. Wait a moment.
errors.no_plugins_for_vanilla: Vanilla servers can't use plugins or mods.
errors.modrinth_error: Modrinth didn't respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_compatible_version: There's no version of this for Minecraft {{version}}.
errors.checksum_mismatch: The downloaded file was damaged. Try again.
errors.invalid_player_name: Player names have 3–16 letters, numbers or underscores.
errors.public_ip_unknown: Couldn't find your public internet address.
errors.upnp_failed: The router didn't allow opening the port. Turn on UPnP in the router, or forward the port by hand.
errors.upnp_timeout: No router answered. UPnP may be off; forward the port by hand or use the tunnel.
errors.cloudflare_bad_token: Cloudflare didn't accept this token. Copy it again, including every character.
errors.cloudflare_no_zones: This token can't see any domain. Create it again with "All zones" selected.
errors.invalid_domain: Use only letters, numbers and dashes in the name.
errors.domain_in_use: The server "{{name}}" already uses this address.
errors.invalid_ip: That isn't a valid IPv4 address.
errors.invalid_max_players: Choose a maximum number of players between 1 and 500.
errors.storage_not_writable: ZimaMC can't write to {{path}}. Pick another folder; on ZimaOS it must be under /DATA or /media.
errors.not_enough_space: There is not enough free space on that disk.
errors.target_exists: There is already a server folder at {{path}}.
errors.invalid_radius: Choose a radius between 100 and 30,000 blocks.

details.noCompatible: There's no version of this for your server's Minecraft version.
details.clientRequired: Every player also has to install this mod in their game, otherwise they can't join.

services.title: Maps and add-ons
services.hint: Found automatically from your plugins and mods. If a link doesn't work yet, restart the server. Web maps are only reachable from your home network.
services.bluemap: BlueMap only starts rendering after you accept its download: in Files, open plugins/BlueMap/core.conf, set accept-download: true and restart.

ports.title: Extra ports
ports.hint: For plugins or mods that need their own port. Known ones (web maps, voice chat, Geyser) are added automatically.
ports.label: Name

windows.stayOn: ZimaMC is running on this PC: your servers are only online while it is switched on and awake. Docker Desktop has to be running.

storage.mountHint: Only ZimaMC's own folder is available. On ZimaOS, re-import ZimaMC with the latest docker-compose.yml so your other drives (/media) and /DATA show up here.
storage.customHint: ZimaMC creates a ZimaMC folder inside. On ZimaOS the folder must be under /DATA or /media.
storage.title: Storage
storage.moveHint: Moving copies the world, plugins and settings, then deletes the old copy.
storage.stopFirst: Stop the server to move it.
storage.moveText: This can take a while for big worlds. The server can't start until it's done.
storage.backupsText: Keeping backups on a different disk than your worlds protects them if a disk fails. Existing backups are moved too.

chunky.title: Pre-generate the world?
chunky.text: Chunky creates the land around spawn ahead of time. Without it, the server builds new land while players explore, which is what makes servers lag. It runs once in the background, and you can play while it works.
chunky.yesText: Smooth exploring from day one. Takes some time and disk space once.
chunky.noText: The world is created as players explore. You can add Chunky later.
chunky.custom: Or your own radius in blocks
chunky.summary: {{chunks}} chunks: about {{size}} on disk ({{free}} free) and {{time}} of generating.
chunky.estimateHint: Estimated from a quick test of this machine. Real times vary with the version, mods and what else is running.
chunky.installFailed: The server was created, but Chunky could not be installed. {{reason}} You can add it on the Plugins or Mods page.

pregen.title: World pre-generation
pregen.waiting: Chunky will generate {{radius}} blocks around spawn when the server starts.
pregen.offline: Paused while the server is offline. Chunky continues when it starts.
pregen.done: Done: {{radius}} blocks around spawn are ready.
pregen.failed: Chunky didn't start. Check that it is installed on the Plugins or Mods page, then start it in the console with “chunky start”.
pregen.hint: Players can join while it runs.
pregen.cancelText: Land generated so far stays. You can start again later from the console.
